articles.title: Brother Behind School Executive's Contract Killing? Shimla Murder Probe Takes Shocking Turn
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Seventeen days after the murder of 41-year-old school executive Manisha Mittal in Shimla, police have arrested her younger brother and an alleged accomplice for allegedly conspiring to have her killed over a property dispute.

body.html:
Seventeen days after the murder of 41-year-old school executive Manisha Mittal in Shimla, police have arrested her younger brother and an alleged accomplice for allegedly conspiring to have her killed over a property dispute.

The prime accused has been identified as Himank Mittal (31), chairman of Saraswati Paradise International Public School in Sanjauli and the victim's younger brother. The second accused, Gobind, was arrested after returning from Thailand, where he had reportedly travelled two days before the murder.

According to Shimla Police, two alleged shooters from Haryana, Ashish Ahlawat (22) and Deepak Budhwal (25), were arrested on June 16 and remain in police custody.

Additional Superintendent of Police (ASP) Mehar Panwar said the investigation revealed that the murder stemmed from a dispute over the management and ownership of Saraswati Paradise International Public School in Shimla and another school in Rohtak, Haryana.

Police said Manisha allegedly attempted to register a new society for the school in her name, while the existing society was registered under Himank Mittal's name. Investigators are also examining a financial dispute involving an ₹8-crore fixed deposit, which allegedly intensified the family conflict after their father's death.

According to police, Himank allegedly transferred ₹8.5 lakh to Gobind days before the murder. Investigators further alleged that Gobind paid the two shooters ₹70,000, including ₹50,000 in cash and ₹20,000 through a bank transfer.

Manisha Mittal was shot dead outside the entrance of Saraswati Paradise International Public School in Sanjauli on June 13.

Police said Himank, who is currently hospitalised with injuries sustained in a separate attack in Rohtak on June 1, will be brought to Shimla for further questioning once he is declared medically fit.

Before his arrest, Himank had denied any involvement in the murder, claiming he had not been on speaking terms with his sister for a long time.

articles.title: Accident Hotspot': Residents Demand Speed Breakers at Dangerous Banashankari Junction
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A road junction in Bengaluru's Banashankari 3rd Stage has reportedly become an accident hotspot, with multiple crashes being reported near the Ganesha Temple on Kathriguppe Water Tank Park Road, close to 2nd Cross Road.

body.html:
A road junction in Bengaluru's Banashankari 3rd Stage has reportedly become an accident hotspot, with multiple crashes being reported near the Ganesha Temple on Kathriguppe Water Tank Park Road, close to 2nd Cross Road.

Residents have attributed the recurring accidents to overspeeding vehicles and the absence of speed breakers and other traffic-calming measures.

According to locals, the junction poses a serious risk to pedestrians, commuters, senior citizens and children, with the lack of adequate road safety infrastructure making the stretch increasingly unsafe.

Residents have urged the concerned authorities to conduct an immediate inspection and install speed breakers, warning signboards and other traffic-calming measures to reduce vehicle speeds and prevent further accidents.

They have called for urgent intervention, warning that any delay could lead to more accidents and put the lives of road users at risk.

#Bengaluru #Banashankari #RoadSafety #Traffic

articles.title: Pune PSI Suspended After Allegedly Misbehaving With Café Staff and Customers During Night Patrol
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A Police Sub-Inspector (PSI) attached to Deccan Police Station in Pune has been suspended after a CCTV video allegedly showed him misbehaving with customers and staff at a café during a night patrol. The suspended officer has been identified as Sandeep Kadam.

body.html:
A Police Sub-Inspector (PSI) attached to Deccan Police Station in Pune has been suspended after a CCTV video allegedly showed him misbehaving with customers and staff at a café during a night patrol.

The suspended officer has been identified as Sandeep Kadam. The incident reportedly took place in the early hours of June 6 at the Flying Gypsy Café on Shirol Road.

According to Pune Police, Kadam entered the café at around 1:45 am while it was preparing to close for the day. CCTV footage and a complaint filed in the matter allegedly show the officer using his baton to knock coffee glasses and food items off the counter.

Police said the officer also allegedly ordered customers to leave immediately, behaved inappropriately with the café staff and allegedly used abusive language.

The CCTV video later went viral on social media, triggering widespread criticism and prompting Pune Police to initiate an internal inquiry.

Following the inquiry, Additional Commissioner of Police Rajesh Bansode ordered Kadam's suspension, stating that his conduct violated police discipline and tarnished the image of the police force.

Pune Police said departmental proceedings against the officer are underway, and further action will be taken based on the outcome of the inquiry.

#Pune #Maharashtra #Police #CCTV #ViralVideo

articles.title: Eggs, Brinjals Thrown at Mahua Moitra During Party Meeting; TMC MP Blames BJP Workers
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Trinamool Congress (TMC) MP Mahua Moitra alleged that BJP workers threw eggs and brinjals at a building in Krishnanagar, West Bengal, where she was holding a meeting with party workers on Wednesday.

body.html:
Trinamool Congress (TMC) MP Mahua Moitra alleged that BJP workers threw eggs and brinjals at a building in Krishnanagar, West Bengal, where she was holding a meeting with party workers on Wednesday.

According to Moitra, a group of protesters gathered outside the venue, waved black flags, raised "Go Back" slogans and hurled eggs and brinjals towards the building. During a Facebook Live broadcast, she was seen using a curtain to shield herself as the objects were thrown towards the window.

Moitra alleged that the protesters were "BJP goons" and claimed police and CRPF personnel reached the spot around 15 minutes after the incident began.

She also alleged that despite informing senior police officials, the crowd was not dispersed immediately. In a post on X, she claimed police watched the situation for nearly two hours while the mob continued protesting.

The incident comes on the same day the Calcutta High Court directed the West Bengal government to submit a report on recent egg-hurling incidents targeting TMC leaders and asked authorities to take strict action against those responsible. The court observed that such incidents had become a "social evil".

This is the latest in a series of similar incidents targeting TMC leaders since the 2026 West Bengal Assembly elections. Earlier, TMC MP Abhishek Banerjee and several other party leaders were also targeted with eggs during public appearances.

The BJP has denied allegations of orchestrating such attacks.

#WestBengal #MahuaMoitra #TMC #BJP #Krishnanagar

articles.title: Woman and Husband Assaulted on Kanpur Road; Two Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A woman and her husband were allegedly assaulted by the woman's relatives in Uttar Pradesh's Kanpur. A video of the incident has gone viral on social media. According to police, the incident took place in the Barra 8 area under the Gujaini police station limits.

body.html:
A woman and her husband were allegedly assaulted by the woman's relatives in Uttar Pradesh's Kanpur. A video of the incident has gone viral on social media.

According to police, the incident took place in the Barra 8 area under the Gujaini police station limits. The woman was travelling on a motorcycle with her husband and child when they were allegedly stopped by her brother-in-law, Hemant Sharma, and his associate, Sandeep.

Police said the accused allegedly assaulted the woman and her husband. The viral video shows the woman being beaten with slippers, kicks and punches during the altercation, while her husband tried to protect her.

According to reports, the woman was on her way to file a complaint when the incident occurred.

Taking cognisance of the viral video, Gujaini Police registered an FIR under relevant sections based on the victim's complaint.

Both named accused, Hemant Sharma and Sandeep, have been arrested. Further legal proceedings are underway.

#Kanpur #UttarPradesh #ViralVideo #Assault #CrimeNews #BreakingNews

articles.title: Karnataka Man Arrested for Allegedly Strangling Wife Over Dowry and Harassment
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 29-year-old woman was allegedly strangled to death by her husband in Karnataka's Dharwad district. Police have arrested the husband and three others in connection with the murder.

body.html:
A 29-year-old woman was allegedly strangled to death by her husband in Karnataka's Dharwad district. Police have arrested the husband and three others in connection with the murder.

The deceased has been identified as Priyank Kamalakar (29), while the main accused is her husband, Basavaraj Vadder. The incident took place in Khanasi village of Navalgund taluk on June 29.

According to police, Basavaraj, who married Priyank in 2024, had allegedly been harassing her within a year of their marriage, demanding gold and money from her parental family.

Police said he also allegedly taunted Priyank over her weight and claimed she was unable to conceive because she was "fat". She was allegedly strangled to death following the continued harassment.

Priyank's parents were informed about her death on Tuesday morning and later lodged a complaint at Navalgund Police Station.

Police have arrested Basavaraj Vadder along with Renava, Subhash and Siddaramesh in connection with the case. Further investigation is underway.

#Karnataka #Dharwad #MurderCase #CrimeNews #BreakingNews

articles.title: Abhishek Banerjee Shares CCTV Video, Blames BJP for 'Goonda Raj'
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Trinamool Congress (TMC) MP Abhishek Banerjee has shared CCTV footage allegedly showing a motorcycle-borne man throwing stones at the gate of his Kolkata residence and smashing a first-floor window with a large stone.

body.html:
Trinamool Congress (TMC) MP Abhishek Banerjee has shared CCTV footage allegedly showing a motorcycle-borne man throwing stones at the gate of his Kolkata residence and smashing a first-floor window with a large stone.

The CCTV footage, which Banerjee claimed was recorded early on Tuesday, shows a helmeted man wearing a blue T-shirt stopping his motorcycle, picking up a stone and hurling it towards the house. He is seen repeating the act before leaving the spot.

Sharing the video on X, Banerjee alleged that the incident reflected the "complete normalisation of violence under BJP's goonda raj" and questioned the absence of police despite a nearby Kolkata Police kiosk.

"Where was the police? Under whose instructions did this miscreant carry out such a brazen attack and walk away with complete impunity?" Banerjee wrote.

He also questioned whether the newly passed West Bengal Public Safety and Control of Anti-Social Activities Bill, 2026, would be applied to "BJP-backed criminals".

The BJP rejected the allegations. Diamond Harbour BJP MLA Dipak Kumar Haldar dismissed Banerjee's claims, alleging that the TMC leader was attempting to remain politically relevant and seeking enhanced security.

The incident comes amid heightened political tensions in West Bengal. Recently, the Calcutta High Court directed the state government to submit a detailed report on incidents involving stone and egg attacks on political leaders since the 2026 Assembly election results and asked police to frame strict guidelines to curb such violence.

Banerjee had also faced an attack in Sonarpur on May 30, when a mob allegedly hurled stones and eggs at him during a visit to families affected by post-poll violence.

The authenticity of the CCTV footage has not been independently verified.

#WestBengal #AbhishekBanerjee #TMC #BJP #Kolkata

articles.title: Wife's 'Accident' Story Exposed: Sangli Woman, Alleged Lover Arrested for Husband's Murder
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 28-year-old man was allegedly strangled to death by his wife and her alleged lover in Maharashtra's Sangli district, with the accused initially attempting to pass off the murder as an accidental death. The deceased has been identified as Anand Sarje (28).

body.html:
A 28-year-old man was allegedly strangled to death by his wife and her alleged lover in Maharashtra's Sangli district, with the accused initially attempting to pass off the murder as an accidental death.

The deceased has been identified as Anand Sarje (28). The accused are his wife, Pallavi Sarje, and her alleged lover, Deepak Ajmane (23). The incident took place in the Bapat Mala area under the Vishrambag Police Station limits.

According to police, Anand's death was initially registered as accidental on June 25 after Pallavi claimed he had been assaulted by unidentified persons, returned home, gone to sleep and later lost consciousness. He was taken to the Government Hospital in Sangli, where doctors declared him dead on arrival.

However, the post-mortem examination revealed scratch marks on Anand's neck consistent with strangulation, prompting police to launch a detailed investigation.

Police said they monitored Pallavi's movements and detained her for questioning. During sustained interrogation, she allegedly gave contradictory statements before confessing to the crime. Police said she admitted to killing Anand with the help of her alleged lover, Deepak Ajmane.

According to investigators, Pallavi allegedly called Ajmane to the house after an argument with Anand. While Anand was asleep, the two allegedly strangled him to death before fabricating a story to conceal the murder.

Police said Anand and Pallavi had married for love and had two children. Their relationship had been strained for the past two years due to frequent domestic disputes. Pallavi allegedly claimed she had suffered physical and mental abuse from Anand, who was reportedly addicted to alcohol, and cited this as the motive behind the killing.

Police further said Ajmane worked with Anand at a textile shop and later developed a relationship with Pallavi.

Both accused have been arrested and remanded to four days of police custody. Further investigation is underway.

#Sangli #Maharashtra #MurderCase #CrimeNews #BreakingNews

articles.title: Nurse Allegedly Kicks Mentally Ill Man Repeatedly Inside Raebareli District Hospital
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing video from the District Hospital in Uttar Pradesh's Raebareli has gone viral, showing a female nurse allegedly kicking and abusing a mentally ill man multiple times inside the hospital corridor.

body.html:
A disturbing video from the District Hospital in Uttar Pradesh's Raebareli has gone viral, showing a female nurse allegedly kicking and abusing a mentally ill man multiple times inside the hospital corridor.

In the 39-second video, the nurse, identified as Pinky, is seen repeatedly kicking the man, who remains largely passive and offers no visible resistance. She is also heard shouting at him and allegedly abusing him while trying to force him out of the hospital.

The video also shows a security guard standing nearby with folded hands without intervening. Several people are seen walking through the corridor as the alleged assault continues.

The viral clip triggered widespread outrage on social media, with many users demanding strict action against those responsible and questioning the treatment of a vulnerable patient in a government hospital.

Following the video's circulation, Chief Medical Superintendent (CMS) Dr Pushpendra Kumar said the hospital had taken cognisance of the incident and action had been initiated against the nurse. However, he did not disclose the nature of the action or identify the nurse by name in his statement.

Police or district authorities have not yet issued an official statement regarding the authenticity of the video or any further legal action. The matter is under scrutiny.

#Raebareli #UttarPradesh #Hospital #ViralVideo #CCTV

articles.title: Trio in SUV Allegedly Flee After Filling ₹4,711 Diesel at Udupi Petrol Pump
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Three unidentified youths allegedly fled without paying after filling diesel worth ₹4,711 at an Indian Oil fuel station in Subhash Nagar, Shankarpura, Udupi.

body.html:
Three unidentified youths allegedly fled without paying after filling diesel worth ₹4,711 at an Indian Oil fuel station in Subhash Nagar, Shankarpura, Udupi.

According to reports, the trio arrived in a white Ford EcoSport and asked the staff to prepare the bill after filling the tank with diesel. Before the payment could be made, they allegedly sped away from the fuel station.

Fuel station staff said the occupants spoke fluent Tulu and claimed they were from Kumta, though their identities are yet to be verified. Staff also suspected the trio was under the influence of alcohol, as beer bottles and packets of chips were reportedly seen inside the vehicle.

The vehicle had tinted windows, and its registration number could not be captured on the fuel station's CCTV cameras.

A complaint has been lodged with the Shirva Police, who have launched an investigation into the incident.

#Udupi #Karnataka #FuelTheft #IndianOil #CCTV
